state-update-guard.name: State Update Guard (Beta)
state-update-guard.shortDescription: Checks the AI's updates before saving a reply. If the format is missing or broken, it tries to fix it once.
state-update-guard.longDescription:
Helps keep the story's values updating when the AI returns the wrong format. Works with existing cards. Each reply must include valid updates or explicitly say there are no updates. If the check or correction fails, your previous state is kept and that reply is not charged. It checks the format, not whether the story's facts are right.

Checks are free. Only saved corrections with paid Yumina models cost mushies. The default is Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, like Memory. Choose Use free model in the panel for free corrections. With your own API key, Yumina does not charge mushies, but your provider may charge.

Open the panel from the chat toolbar to turn it on or off, choose a correction model, or view what changed. Turning it off restores normal card updates. Uninstalling keeps saved state and history. Installation changes may take up to 60 seconds to take effect.

explanations.title: Works with existing cards
explanations.body: Uses the card's existing variables and commands. No need to rewrite its prompt or interface.

explanations.title: Clear results
explanations.body: See whether a reply needed a fix and which values changed. No updates must be explicitly confirmed. Automatic game rules still run.

explanations.title: Only fixes when needed
explanations.body: Valid replies need no extra model call. Invalid replies get one attempt with your correction model. Saved paid Yumina corrections cost mushies; free models and your own API do not. Your API provider may charge.

session-memory-summary.name: Session Memory & Story Summary (Beta)
session-memory-summary.shortDescription: The AI forgets things in long chats. This keeps notes for it: key facts get recorded, older chat gets compressed into a recap — which also saves tokens. Beta.
session-memory-summary.longDescription:
The AI forgets things in long chats. This extension keeps notes for it in the background: key facts (relationships, items, promises, goals) go into a running list, older chat gets compressed into a "story so far" recap, and both are fed to the AI before every reply — details survive, and every turn costs fewer tokens. There's also an experimental Layered Summary for very long stories.

Note-taking costs a little: the default model is Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, usually well under 1 mushie per update. Don't want to spend anything? Switch it to Yumina Free in the Memory panel.

Everything it writes lives in the Memory panel (the button above the chat input; in a few worlds with fully custom interfaces the button is missing — move your cursor to the top edge and use the play-controls bar). Read it, edit it, clear and regenerate it, change the model, tune when compression kicks in.

Uninstalling just turns it off — your notes are kept, and reinstalling picks them back up. Beta: it occasionally gets a detail wrong.

explanations.title: Session Memory
explanations.body: Key facts go into a running list — relationships, items, promises, open goals — and get fed to the AI before every reply, so details survive long sessions.

explanations.title: Story Summary
explanations.body: Older chat is compressed into a "story so far" recap. The AI keeps the plot without carrying the full transcript, and every turn costs fewer tokens.

explanations.title: Cost & control
explanations.body: Note-taking costs a little (default: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite; one tap in the Memory panel switches it to the free model). Everything it writes can be viewed, edited, or cleared.
